objectives: Protect credentials, workspace content, scientific inputs/outputs, collaboration traffic, and entitlement data in transit.
Keep proprietary implementation/source off untrusted network/client surfaces wherever possible.
Fail closed on insecure transport or invalid authentication.

browser_to_backend.plaintext_http_behavior: redirect only for public entry when deployment requires; never accept authenticated/session API traffic over plaintext
browser_to_backend.samesite_policy: Lax or Strict unless a documented cross-site flow requires otherwise

realtime_transport.websocket_if_added: wss only; authenticated, origin checked, bounded message size/rate
realtime_transport.collaboration: authenticated typed protocol; end-to-end encryption where practical; replay protection required

api_security.audit_events_required_for: auth, membership changes, entitlement changes, privileged run controls, collaborator invites/revocations

packet_inspection_statement.protected_against_passive_payload_readin: when TLS is correctly configured and endpoints are uncompromised
packet_inspection_statement.impossible_claim_prohibited: Do not claim network traffic is invisible or that client-executed code is impossible to reverse engineer.
